name: Punishment Scaling
description: <font color="#6AA84F">Verbal/1 Minute Ban</font> -> <font color="#FF9900">30 Minute Ban</font> -> <font color="#FF9900">1 Hour Ban (60 Minutes)</font> -> <font color="#FF8000">6 Hour Ban (360 Minutes)</font> -> <font color="#EA5C02">1 Day Ban (1440 Minutes)</font> -> <font color="#F33901">1 Week Ban (10080 Minutes)</font> -> <font color="#FF0000">1 Month Ban (40320 Minutes) - Beware that next is permanent</font> -> <font color="#E20202">Permanent Ban [Head Staff needed]</font> -> <font color="#980000">U. Permanent Ban [Head Staff needed]</font>

name: Cheating
description: Cheating is of course not allowed as it is not allowed by the Roblox TOS, it's an instant unappealable ban.

fields.text: Proof is essential for this type of ban. Proof must be at least a 20 second video showing what kind of unfair advantage is being given to the users.
All bans related to cheating are unappealable regardless of the severity.

name: Raiding
description: Multiple users (be it a friend group or an intentional disruption group) breaking either the same rule or multiple rules at the same time is a Severity+1 on the highest rule broken.

fields.text: Raiding doesn't necessarily mean a group; Breaking multiple rules at once in order to cause disruption, even if alone, is counted as raiding.
In such a case where a solo user is raiding, a permanent ban is applicable.

name: Innapropriate Actions
description: This includes, but is not limited to - W+S'ing any other player, having conversions regarding mature or problematic topics, and acting in an innapropriate way towards any other player.

fields.text: Staff is not obligated to verbally warn you if you are behaving inappropriately and may instead kick you or imprison you as a form of warning.
If Staff Members find your rule break to be severe, they are not obligated to verbally warn you and may instead temporarily ban you.
Multiple violations can and will result in a ban or permanent ban.

name: In Game Avatars
description: Please do not wear avatars that contains any innapropriate accessories (ex. shirt shaders) and keep avatars in the game's age rating (being 5+ as of writing this)

name: Ban Evasion
description: Evading bans using alts is not tolerated and will result in your ban becoming unappealable and a + 1 scaling for each iteration of this happening. (The alt receiving a permanent ban)

name: Staff Annoyance (& Stalking)
description: Consistently following staff members into servers they are located in would result in a ban

fields.text: Breaking additional rules will be considered raiding as well.

name: Staff Harassment
description: Same as Staff Annoyance, but using alts to avoid bans related to stalking / annoyance.

fields.text: Staff Impersonation falls under this category.

name: Same Offense
description: If a player keeps doing the same offense over and over, you may skip a scaling level.

name: Excessive Toxicity
description: This is Roblox we are talking about, so there is bound to be toxic players; That said, if a player gets excessively toxic (as in verbal abuse, NOT spamming 'ez'), staff members should intervene. The punishment is relative to the severity, but otherwise the scaling is default.

name: Recording unreleased content without permssion
description: You cannot record (nor publish) gameplay of a unreleased song (ex: after playing against a developer) without explicit permission
